newsitem.title: USA: Valhi Inc sells Irish fiberboard unit.
newsitem.headline: Valhi Inc sells Irish fiberboard unit.

text.p: Valhi Inc said on Wednesday it completed the previously announced sale of its Irish medium density fiberboard operations to Willamette Industries Inc for $61.5 million in cash and the assumption of debt.
The Irish unit's debt is about $21 million, Valhi said.
Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, the company said.
Valhi closed the sale of its Oregon timber and timberlands for $118 million, which paid down $53 million of Medite, a Valhi subsidiary's, bank debt.
Valhi is presently negotiating the sale of the Medford, Oregon sawmill and fiberboard facilities, which would remove the company from the building products business, the company said.
